    27	/-- An admissible operation-indexed execution in the standard relative-rounding

    29	`blockAddError b t` belongs to inserting offset `t` (only `t ≥ 1` is used);
    30	`reductionError b` belongs to inserting partial `b` (only `b ≥ 1` is used).

    32	execution of an actual rounding operation satisfying the model. -/

    35	  blockAddError : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
